messages:
kevin: Kicking off the region cutover planning thread for the weekend window. target: US -> EU -> APAC, start in ~2h. proposal: pin EU to v2.3.1 for validation, keep US on v2.3.0 for steady traffic until warmup completes. thoughts?
rachel: +1 on pinning EU. can we confirm dedicated pool headroom first (gpu slots + burst)?
deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: release/v2.3.1 -> staged rollout. Canary: US-10% (30m), EU-5% (15m), APAC-0% initially. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/v2.3.1
maria: Ops check: current reserved capacity: US 120 infer nodes (80% util at peak), EU 60 (65% util), APAC 40 (50%). With v2.3.1 perf delta (+8% tokens/s), EU should be fine but APAC needs warmup.
sophia: Add runbook note: if EU p99 latency > 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes, rollback EU to v2.3.0 and shift traffic to US fallback pool.
ops-oncall: Noted. What are the rollback signals? CPU/GPU temp? queue length?
kevin: Rollback triggers: p99 latency spike >350ms x3m OR error rate >1% sustained x2m OR prefix cache miss rate >25% with rising queues. Manual abort allowed by oncall.
aj: Also add model-variant fallback: if quantized variant causes regressions, auto-fallback to fp16 variant in same slice. deploy-bot can toggle pin.
deploy-bot: Pin action available: `/pin release/v2.3.1 region=eu duration=2h reason="canary validation"`
kevin: We'll run quick smoke: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run-smoke -d '{"region":"eu","suite":"latency-basic"}'` during EU canary. please post results here.
maria: Scheduled smoke in 10m. expected token throughput baseline: 120k tokens/min EU. will post after run.
ops-oncall: Also watch quota: EU per-tenant concurrency limit 5000, global slice cushion must keep 20% spare. Current cushion is ~18% so we need to free ~200 concurrency to be safe.
sophia: Suggest reducing noncritical background batching jobs in EU for 30m to free cushion. I can push that change.
rachel: Release notes sync: add note about quantization toggles and recommended fallback. I'll update the release notes doc and link once done.
kevin: Good. decision: pin EU -> v2.3.1 for canary (2h), keep US on v2.3.0, APAC hold. If EU passes smoke + 15m steady, we increment EU traffic to 25% then schedule APAC warmup.
maria: Smoke results: latency median 28ms, p99 310ms, error rate 0.12%, token throughput 122k tokens/min. baseline met.
aj: +1 proceed to gradual ramp per plan. I'll throttle background jobs now.
sophia: Background jobs reduced. freeing ~250 concurrency. cushion now ~23%.
kevin: Ramp EU to 25% in 10m. ops-oncall standby. If any rollback trigger hit, rollback immediately and notify #eng-oncall and #product.
deploy-bot: Rolling EU to 25% traffic. monitor: latency, errors, cache-miss. Expected completion 2m.
devops-bot: Reminder: change window ends at 03:00 UTC. Any hotfixes after that require oncall + release owner approval.
ops-oncall: Observability: p99 currently 315ms, error rate 0.15%, queue length stable. continuing to monitor.
kevin: If EU stays healthy for 20m at 25%, we schedule APAC warmup: canary APAC at 5% pointing to v2.3.1 variant with pinned warm pool.
rachel: I'll publish updated release notes now and ping sales/support with recovery/rollback summary.
maria: Noted: leaving pool warmers on for APAC prepares next step.
aj: FYI: if APAC GPU pool cold start risk remains, we may do a short pre-warm job: `./warm_pool --region=apac --nodes=8 --duration=15m`
sophia: Agree run pre-warm 15m before APAC canary.
kevin: Thanks all. summary: pin EU, monitor p99 <350ms & error <1%, free cushion to >=20%, background jobs trimmed, planned APAC warmup pending EU steady state. rollback runbook in thread.
rachel: noted and will circulate final release note + postmortem template in #incidents if something slides. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment notes attached: changelog v2.3.1: Improved kv-cache eviction, kernel selection tweaks, quantization profile updates. See internal changelog: https://changelog.internal/v2.3.1
maria: Closing loop: EU steady at 30m, p99 320ms, no regression signals. proceeding to APAC pre-warm in 5m.
ops-oncall: I am watching; will escalate on first trigger.
kevin: Great work. keep updates short here. after APAC warms we'll reconvene for final cutover decision.
